before.title: HydroLAKES v1.0 — global lake polygons
before.description: The complete HydroLAKES v1.0 polygon layer in spatially ordered GeoParquet, preserving producer fields and geometry for lake analysis and joins. A separately versioned PMTiles layer provides generalized map display and source-ID attribute lookup.
